A woman is immediately in front of the camera, seated or reclining on the woven cot and facing down toward fabric and yarn within her reach. Another person sits closely beside her on the right, while more distant people are visible beyond the cot. Nobody appears to be blocking the camera wearer’s path. Because they are engaged in textile work—not paperwork, a meeting, or a picnic—the best response is to ask whether they need assistance without touching their materials.
